model_annotation: The plot illustrates how a metric labeled “Coverage” varies as the “Number of completions (i)” increases, with four model/setting series shown together. The x-axis is labeled “Number of completions (i)” and uses a logarithmic base-2 style tick labeling with values shown as powers of two from 2^0 through 2^8 at regular one-exponent intervals. The y-axis is labeled “Coverage” on a linear scale, spanning approximately from 0.2 up to 0.8 with evenly spaced tick marks at about 0.2 intervals (0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). The series labeled “Llama-3B” is drawn in green with triangle markers connected by a solid line, starting near 0.38 at 2^0, rising to around 0.50 by roughly 2^6, and then tapering slightly to about 0.42–0.45 by 2^8. The “Llama-3B + FT” series is drawn in blue with circular markers and a solid line, beginning around 0.38 at 2^0, increasing to roughly 0.50 around 2^6–2^7, and ending near 0.44–0.46 at 2^8. The “Llama-1B” series appears in a lighter cyan/blue tone with circular markers and a solid line, starting close to 0.22 at 2^0 and increasing steadily to about 0.36–0.38 by 2^8. The “Llama-1B + FT” series is shown in light green with triangle markers and a solid line, beginning near 0.22 at 2^0, rising gradually toward approximately 0.38–0.40 by around 2^7, and ending near 0.36–0.38 at 2^8.
